I hear the GTX900 series is the series looking to rebuild bridges to the Unix community.

You heard wrong. They require signed firmware now. If you want Unix compatibility, go Intel or AMD. nVidia closed drivers are ok (they've always been), but they rip out the OSS infrastructure and place in their own closed one. No KMS, every kernel you'll need to worry if the driver still works, your kernel will be tainted (no bug reports/support) and you'll be behind for wayland support. These issues will vary with each distro.
"Tainted" kernel is fine. Don't let the phrase scare you. All it means is that you'll have the best video driver for your device that is available ..unless you're using AMD.
